description: Canonical trust-tier enforcement policy for actor promotion. Maps promotion tiers to governance trust tiers, validation independence requirements, and enforcement rules. JSON is canonical; markdown summaries must not introduce requirements beyond this document.

restricted.description: Demotion target. No capabilities until operator manual restore.

candidate.description: New actor. Read-only observation. Building initial evidence.

probationary.description: Observed actor. Review and triage permitted. Building review agreement evidence.

trusted_low_risk.description: Trusted for low-risk patches. Must demonstrate patch quality.

trusted_patch.description: Trusted for autonomous patches and full-auto. Proving escalation behavior.

trusted_complex.description: Highest tier. Trusted for complex work, deep review, and planning.

enforcement_rules.actor_identity_required: All promotion and demotion decisions must resolve the actor's canonical identity triple (actor_id, actor_type, harness_id) from the actor registry before evaluation.
enforcement_rules.distinct_intelligence_gate: Promotion from probationary and above requires distinct-intelligence validation: validated_by_actor_id != produced_by_actor_id AND validated_by_harness_id != produced_by_harness_id AND validated_by_actor_type == 'intelligence'.
enforcement_rules.no_self_promotion: An actor cannot produce the evidence that promotes itself. Evidence must be validated by a distinct intelligence.
enforcement_rules.no_ritual_validation: Human review does not satisfy distinct-intelligence validation for AI-produced promotion-grade evidence. Validation must exercise the evidence artifacts directly (anti_theater_check).
enforcement_rules.trace_emission_required: Every promotion or demotion decision must emit a trace event to the canonical trace surface with event_type 'task_outcome' and scope 'actor-promotion'.
enforcement_rules.validation_independence_scales: Validation independence requirements scale with governance trust tier. See validation_independence_tier per promotion tier.
enforcement_rules.auxiliary_eval_distinction: Local-intelligence auxiliary evaluations (exploratory checks, pre-review validation) are permitted but do NOT satisfy distinct-intelligence validation or acceptance-grade review gates.
